hardFailures.message: Visual competition / module crowding: The glowing open door at the right edge (bright vertical light and strong lens flare) competes with the headline 'CHEGOU O DIA' (top-left hook) and the primary CTA button 'Saiba mais' (large neon pill near bottom-center). Observed zones: hook headline (top-left), NR1 offer block (lower-left), feature bullet panel with icons (center-right), glowing door (right edge), CTA pill (bottom-center) — more than three prominent zones fighting for attention.

Legibility risk at thumbnail: Secondary copy in the feature panel ('EVENTO 100% ONLINE E AO VIVO', 'CONTEÚDO PRÁTICO E DIRETO AO PONTO', 'GARANTA SUA VAGA AGORA') and the smaller line 'CHECKLIST DE SEGURANÇA / ONLINE & AO VIVO' under NR1 are small and use low micro-contrast against the neon-green glow. At feed/thumbnail scale these support texts will likely be unreadable.

Generic neon template aesthetic: Heavy neon-green glow on the CTA pill, headline outline, and door, plus hex-pattern background, creates a stylized 'tech/neon' look that isn't clearly justified by the compliance-focused brief. This reduces perceived authenticity for a safety/compliance offering and risks appearing as a generic template.
